C14 closely matches the child's current tax categories, years, Congress, Treasury Decisions, and closing clauses, but addresses a different committee and investigative purpose.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"shall, during the Eighty-sixth Congress, be open to inspection by the Committee on Un-American Activities, House of Representatives, or any duly authorized subcommittee thereof, for the purpose of carrying on those investigations authorized by clause 17 of Rule XI","parent_excerpt":"shall, during the Eighty-fifth Congress, be open to inspection by the Committee on Un-American Activities, House of Representatives, or any duly authorized sub-committee thereof, for the purpose of carrying on those investigations authorized by clause 17 of Rule XI","explanation":"Distinctive, nearly verbatim authorization identifying the same committee, subcommittees, and investigative authority."},{"child_excerpt":"such inspection to be in accordance and upon compliance with the rules and regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Treasury in Treasury Decisions 6132 and 6133","parent_excerpt":"such inspection to be in accordance and upon compliance with the rules and regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Treasury in Treasury Decisions 6132 and 6133","explanation":"Identical administrative machinery governing inspection."},{"child_excerpt":"This order shall be effective upon its filing for publication in the FEDERAL REGISTER.","parent_excerpt":"This order shall be effective upon its filing for publication in the FEDERAL REGISTER.","explanation":"The same closing effectiveness clause completes the parallel operative sequence."}]}
